usage: Used for the outer covering of a tree; a very common noun in gardening, nature, and science contexts.
Usually appears with tree-related nouns, e.g. after a tree name or in descriptions of texture, colour, damage, or insects on a tree.
Can be used in both everyday speech and more formal writing; the tone is neutral and natural.
Learners should remember it as a fixed noun phrase: 樹皮, with no classifier needed in ordinary use.
